weather.note: 🌡️ 今天（8/15 週六）台北是這個夏天最需要認真對待的一天：中央氣象署對台北發布高溫資訊，白天高溫上看 35–36°C、局部甚至更高，低溫約 28°C，天氣型態是「多雲到晴＋午後雷陣雨」。　重點不是下不下雨，而是熱。35°C 以上、濕度七八成的環境，體感溫度會被推到 40°C 上下，這已經不是「悶」而是熱傷害風險區：中暑（heat stroke）與熱衰竭（heat exhaustion）的差別在於前者核心體溫失控、會意識改變，是急症。　實務建議：① 11:00–15:00 盡量不要在戶外連續活動，要出門就走騎樓、捷運地下街；② 水分要「定時喝」不要「渴了才喝」，一小時 300–500 ml，流汗多時補一點鹽（運動飲料稀釋一半即可）；③ 午後雷陣雨仍要帶傘，但今天傘的主要功能其實是遮陽；④ 如果今天要在外面待久（例如出遊或家教通勤），把行程排在早上或傍晚。

items.deadline: 講座 2026/8/31（一）10:00–11:20 · 報名表單已開放、額滿為止 —— 到今天為止仍未看到你完成報名的回信
items.kind: 需報名（本區唯一需要動作的事項；已進入第三天未處理）
items.detail: 這封信是 8/13 上午進來的，落在「48 小時內含截止日的成大重點」範圍，所以今天再提醒一次：報名還沒做。　主辦是成大前瞻醫療器材科技中心（MDIC）。主題是 AI 如何把濕實驗室（Wet Lab，指實際操作試劑與儀器的實驗室）的資料處理與模型預測接到臨床應用，也就是加速轉譯科學（translational science，把基礎研究轉成臨床可用技術的學門）。講者馮玉蓮博士（Yiu-Lian Fong, PhD, MBA）現任新加坡分子診斷公司 MiRXES 資深科學顧問兼企業策略顧問、DxRxPM Biotech Consulting 創辦人，先前是嬌生（J&J）旗下 Janssen 的全球臨床生物標記與診斷策略主管——是產業界真的在做決策的人，不是純學術演講。　對化工背景的你，價值在兩層：內容上，生物標記（biomarker）篩選、製程與資料建模、用模型預測取代部分實驗設計，跟化工的程序模擬、DOE（Design of Experiments，實驗設計）、資料驅動最佳化是同一套方法論，只是換到生醫題材；人脈上，一位從大藥廠全球職位走到新創顧問的講者，Q&A 是問「產業界怎麼看 AI 導入的實際瓶頸」的好機會。　時間地點：2026/8/31（一）10:00–11:20，成大生醫卓群大樓 4 樓交誼廳。洽詢 06-2757575 分機 31211，報名連結在信件正文的 Google 表單，另附海報 PDF。　今天要做的只有一件事：把表單填掉，然後用下方按鈕把 8/31 推進 Notion。8/31 是開學前一週，這種行程最容易被排擠掉，先卡位。

items.en: Zambia's Presidential Election Enters a Tense Standoff as Both Camps Claim Victory
items.zh: 尚比亞大選陷入對峙：在野黨自行宣布勝選，現任總統只說「結果令人鼓舞」
items.summary: Zambia's presidential race turned tense on Friday when opposition leader Brian Mundubile declared victory based on his party's own parallel vote tabulation, while incumbent Hakainde Hichilema stopped short of claiming a win and said only that early results were encouraging. Hichilema's UPND separately circulated figures putting him at 56.2 percent against Mundubile's 39.6. Neither set of numbers is official: only the Electoral Commission of Zambia can declare a result, and counting was still under way. Turnout was low, with just over four million of more than eight million registered voters casting ballots.

items.en: Oil Stockpiles Drain Faster as Strait of Hormuz Traffic Stays Near Zero Half a Year Into the War
items.zh: 美伊開戰近半年，荷姆茲海峽船運仍近乎停擺，全球石油庫存加速消耗
items.summary: Nearly six months into the US-Iran war, global oil stockpiles are being drawn down at an accelerating pace because traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains close to nothing. Roughly a fifth of the world's seaborne crude normally passes through the waterway, so even a partial closure forces refiners to lean on reserves rather than fresh cargoes. The buffer that has kept prices from spiking is finite. Analysts now say the market is trading the question of how many weeks of cover remain, rather than the headline risk of a formal closure that has already effectively happened.

items.en: US Sends Carrier USS George Washington to the Middle East to Relieve the Abraham Lincoln
items.zh: 美國調派華盛頓號航艦赴中東，接替超期部署的林肯號
items.summary: The United States is sending the aircraft carrier USS George Washington to the Middle East to replace the USS Abraham Lincoln, which has been on an unusually extended deployment because of the war against Iran. Carrier rotations are routine in isolation, but the timing matters: keeping continuous carrier presence in the region for six months has strained the deployment cycle and the crews. The move signals Washington expects the current posture to hold rather than wind down, and it removes any near-term expectation that US naval presence in the Gulf will thin out.

items.en: Poland Says It Foiled a Russian Plot to Kill a Ukrainian-American in Warsaw
items.zh: 波蘭稱破獲俄羅斯在華沙暗殺烏克蘭裔美國公民的計畫
items.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said on Thursday that Poland had thwarted a Russian plot to kill a Ukrainian-American citizen in Warsaw before it could be carried out. Poland has become a front-line state for this category of operation because it is the main logistics corridor for Western aid to Ukraine and hosts a large Ukrainian population. Separately, a NATO jet shot down a drone that entered Latvian airspace on Friday, according to Latvia's defence ministry. Both incidents fit a pattern of pressure applied below the threshold that would trigger a collective response.

items.en: Boat Carrying 14 People Capsizes Near the Statue of Liberty, Triggering a Multiagency Search
items.zh: 載有 14 人的船隻在自由女神像附近翻覆，紐約港展開跨機構搜救
items.summary: A boat carrying fourteen people capsized near the Statue of Liberty, setting off a multiagency search across one of the busiest stretches of New York Harbor. The waters around Liberty Island combine heavy ferry traffic, commercial shipping and strong tidal currents, which makes both the accident and the rescue harder than the calm-looking surface suggests. Response involved city, state and federal marine units. The incident renews attention on how small passenger vessels are inspected and how quickly they can be located when they go over in a channel with this much traffic.

items.en: An Unreleased Research Claude Pushed the Riemann Zeta Bound From 41.6% to 67.2%
items.zh: 未發表的研究版 Claude 把黎曼 zeta 假設下界從 41.6% 推進到 67.2%
items.summary: An unreleased research version of Claude improved a lower bound related to the Riemann zeta hypothesis from 41.6 percent to 67.2 percent by synthesising recent papers, orchestrating roughly sixty subagents that ran about 2,400 shell commands and thousands of numerical validation checks. The number itself matters less than the method: the model was not asked to prove a theorem in one shot but to run a long, parallel, self-checking research campaign. That is the shape of what frontier labs now mean by autonomous research, and it is closer to how a lab group actually works.

items.en: OpenAI's GPT-5.6-Cyber Reportedly Found Two Chrome Zero-Days
items.zh: OpenAI 新推的 GPT-5.6-Cyber 據報找出兩個 Chrome 零日漏洞
items.summary: OpenAI's newly released GPT-5.6-Cyber model reportedly discovered two zero-day vulnerabilities in Chrome. Zero-days are flaws unknown to the vendor, so there is no patch at the moment of discovery, which is why automated discovery cuts both ways: the same capability that helps defenders audit large codebases lowers the cost of finding exploitable bugs for everyone else. The release pushes the industry conversation from whether models can do security research to how disclosure and access should be gated when the finder is a general-purpose system anyone can rent.

items.en: Gemini App Crosses One Billion Monthly Active Users, Google's Fastest-Growing Product
items.zh: Gemini App 突破 10 億月活躍用戶，成為 Google 史上成長最快的產品
items.summary: Sundar Pichai announced that the Gemini app has crossed one billion monthly active users, describing it as the company's fastest-growing product ever. Distribution explains much of the number: Gemini is threaded through Android, Search and Workspace, so the funnel is unlike anything a standalone assistant can build. The figure is best read as reach rather than engagement, since monthly actives do not distinguish a daily power user from someone who tapped a suggestion once. Still, it sets the scale competitors have to answer at the consumer layer.

items.en: Tigers Shut Out the Guardians Without Recording a Single Strikeout, a First Since 2014
items.zh: 老虎完封守護者卻沒投出半次三振，2014 年以來大聯盟首見
items.summary: The Detroit Tigers shut out the Cleveland Guardians without recording a single strikeout, something no Major League team had done since 2014. A strikeout-free shutout runs against everything modern pitching is optimised for: staffs are built to miss bats, and defence-dependent outs are treated as a risk to be minimised. Doing it means twenty-seven outs all put in play and all converted, which requires positioning and glovework as much as pitching. It is the kind of line score that says more about defensive alignment than about dominance on the mound.

items.en: Yankees Open a Three-Game Set With Toronto as the AL East Race Tightens
items.zh: 洋基迎戰藍鳥展開三連戰，美聯東區戰況收緊
items.summary: The Yankees hosted the Blue Jays to begin a three-game series on Friday, one of several divisional matchups that carry outsized weight with roughly six weeks left in the regular season. Head-to-head series in August function as two-game swings in the standings because a win simultaneously adds to one team's total and denies the direct rival, which is why they are worth more than the same games played in April. The American League playoff picture has stayed unusually compressed this year, leaving little margin in any single series.

items.en: Brewers Take a 1-0 Series Lead Over the Dodgers in a Likely Playoff Preview
items.zh: 釀酒人對道奇取得系列賽 1-0 領先，被視為季後賽預演
items.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers carried a 1-0 series lead into their meeting with the Los Angeles Dodgers, a matchup being read as a possible National League playoff preview. Interleague and cross-division series between likely postseason clubs matter less for the standings than for the scouting file: rotations get seen, bullpen usage patterns get logged, and managers learn which matchups they will want in October. The Dodgers have spent the season as the National League benchmark, so any club that takes a series from them adjusts its own internal expectations.

items.en: Educational Psychology Review Publishes a Call to Integrate Motivation, Self-Regulation, Metacognition and Personality
items.zh: 《Educational Psychology Review》發表整合動機、自我調節、後設認知與人格研究的新方向
items.summary: Educational Psychology Review published an article on 3 August titled 'Beyond Boundaries', arguing that motivation, self-regulation, metacognition and personality have been studied as separate literatures for too long even though they describe the same student. The practical claim is that interventions built on one construct alone tend to fade, because the mechanism they target is entangled with the others. For anyone designing their own study habits, the useful reading is that motivation without a self-regulation routine, or a routine without metacognitive checking, is only a third of the system.

items.en: National Trial Finds Montessori Preschool Children Enter Kindergarten Ahead on Reading and Executive Function
items.zh: 全國性試驗：蒙特梭利公立幼兒園學童入學時的閱讀、記憶與執行功能領先同儕
items.summary: A first-of-its-kind national trial published this year found that children from public Montessori preschools entered kindergarten with stronger reading, memory and executive function than peers from other settings. Executive function, the umbrella term for working memory, inhibition and cognitive flexibility, is the finding worth noting, because it predicts later academic outcomes more reliably than early reading scores do. The trial design matters as much as the result: randomised allocation is rare in early-years research, where families usually self-select into programmes and confound the comparison.

items.en: Meta-Analyses Sharpen the Question of When Feedback Helps in Computer-Assisted Learning
items.zh: 新的統合分析聚焦：電腦輔助學習中「回饋時機」到底何時有效
items.summary: A current strand of educational psychology research is using meta-analysis to examine how the timing of feedback changes learning outcomes in computer-assisted environments. The emerging picture is that immediate feedback helps most for procedural skills where an error compounds, while delayed feedback can be better for conceptual learning because it forces retrieval before correction. The distinction matters for anyone using AI tutors or problem-set software, since most tools default to instant correction, which is the setting least likely to build durable understanding.

items.en: SanDisk Lays Out a 2030 Roadmap Targeting 80% Non-GAAP Gross Margin; Stock Up Over 6%
items.zh: SanDisk 投資人日公布 2030 藍圖、非 GAAP 毛利率上看 80%，股價漲逾 6%
items.summary: SanDisk used its 2026 investor day to publish a NAND technology roadmap for the AI era together with financial targets covering fiscal 2028 to 2030, guiding to mid-to-high double-digit revenue growth and non-GAAP gross margin approaching 80 percent. Eighty percent gross margin is an extraordinary claim for a memory business, a segment historically defined by commodity pricing and brutal cycles, and it only works if AI demand keeps NAND supply structurally tight. The stock has risen sharply this year, so the guidance is now the thing holding the valuation up.

items.en: Global Semiconductor Sales Hit $403.3 Billion in Q2 2026, Up 35.1% From Q1
items.zh: 2026 第二季全球半導體銷售額達 4,033 億美元，季增 35.1%
items.summary: Global semiconductor sales reached $403.3 billion in the second quarter of 2026, an increase of 35.1 percent over the first quarter. A quarter-on-quarter jump of that size is not a normal cyclical recovery; it reflects AI datacentre buildouts pulling in logic, memory and advanced packaging simultaneously rather than in the usual staggered sequence. The read-across for Taiwan is direct, since foundry, packaging and testing all sit on the same demand curve. The risk in a number this steep is that it sets a comparison base that is hard to grow against next year.

items.en: IonQ Crosses 99.99% Two-Qubit Gate Fidelity; Pasqal Traps Neutral Atoms on a Photonic Chip
items.zh: IonQ 兩量子位元閘保真度突破 99.99%，Pasqal 以光子晶片捕捉中性原子
items.summary: IonQ announced 99.99 percent two-qubit gate fidelity using Electronic Qubit Control technology from its Oxford Ionics acquisition, becoming the first quantum company to cross the four-nines threshold on R&D prototypes intended to underpin 256-qubit systems. Separately Pasqal trapped individual neutral atoms using on-chip photonic integrated circuits with its subsidiary Aeponyx. Four nines matters because error correction overhead falls steeply as physical gate error drops, which is what turns a demonstration into a machine. No single qubit modality has established dominance.
items.source: The Quantum Insider / Quantum Computing Report

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE Set 30 September for Their 6th Album and Announced a 28-Date Arena Tour, 'Ringo Jam Tour SHADOWS'
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第六張原創專輯定 9/30 發行，並宣布睽違三年的全國巡迴「Ringo Jam Tour SHADOWS」，13 地 28 場
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE confirmed that their sixth original full album arrives on 30 September 2026, announced live on their own variety programme, alongside their first arena tour in three years. The 'Ringo Jam Tour SHADOWS' runs 28 shows across 13 venues, opening at Anabuki Arena Kagawa on 30 September and closing at Aichi Sky Expo on 28 December. Album pre-orders carry a GREEN CODE whose first benefit is fan-club priority ticket balloting. No Taiwan or Hong Kong dates are included; this is a Japan-only run.

items.en: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour Adds Kaohsiung on 31 October — the Only Taiwan Date
items.zh: 藤井風 Prema 世界巡迴加場：10/31 高雄，是本次唯一台灣場；香港場已取消
items.summary: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour, supporting his fully English third album Prema, has added a Kaohsiung date on 31 October 2026, followed by Bangkok on 26 December and Seoul on 9 January 2027. The Asian leg covers dome and stadium venues in six cities including Fukuoka, Osaka and Tokyo. The Hong Kong show was cancelled without explanation in April, so Kaohsiung is now the closest stop to Taipei. European and North American legs are planned into summer 2027. For a Taiwan-based fan this is the single date to plan around.

items.en: Kenshi Yonezu's 'GHOST' Arena Tour Runs 6 November to 17 December Across Six Cities
items.zh: 米津玄師「2026 TOUR / GHOST」11/6 開跑，日本 6 都市 14 場；抽選結果已於 8/12 公布
items.summary: Kenshi Yonezu's arena tour 'Kenshi Yonezu 2026 TOUR / GHOST' runs from 6 November to 17 December 2026 across six Japanese cities and fourteen dates. The general lottery closed on 26 July and results were released at noon on 12 August, so anyone who entered should have checked by now. No Taiwan or Hong Kong dates have been announced. For overseas fans the realistic route remains a Japan leg combined with the resale rounds that typically open closer to each venue date, rather than waiting for an Asia extension.

items.en: Yonezu and Mrs. GREEN APPLE Lead MUSIC AWARDS JAPAN 2026 Entries; Ado, YOASOBI, LiSA and Fujii Kaze All Nominated
items.zh: 米津玄師與 Mrs. GREEN APPLE 領跑 MUSIC AWARDS JAPAN 2026 入圍數，Ado、YOASOBI、LiSA、藤井風全數在列
items.summary: MUSIC AWARDS JAPAN 2026 revealed its full entry list, covering roughly 2,000 works across 78 categories. Kenshi Yonezu leads the major categories with twelve entries, including five in Best Song and five in Best Global Hit from Japan. Mrs. GREEN APPLE and YOASOBI follow with eleven each, Ado has eight and Fujii Kaze seven, with LiSA also nominated. The Best Global Hit from Japan category is the one to watch, since it tracks which songs are actually travelling outside Japan rather than which are charting domestically.

market.note: 昨天（8/14 週五）台美兩邊都是「指數下跌、但盤面很強」的一天，這種背離值得看懂。　【台股】加權指數開高走低，終場收 45,811.01 點、下跌 210.47 點（-0.46%），46K 得而復失，成交量 10,645.11 億元。早盤開高 82 點、盤中最高一度衝到 46,402.6 點，最低 45,798.31 點，等於全天走勢是一路走弱。指數下跌幾乎全部由權值股貢獻：台積電最後一盤下殺、收 2,395 元（-40 元、-1.64%），日月光投控、聯電、鴻海（259.5 元、-2.5 元）、聯發科（4,210 元、-15 元）同步走弱。　但指數以外的盤面其實非常熱：外資買超 453.51 億元、連 5 買，全週買超 2,061 億元，買最多的是力積電（14 萬 4,966 張、連 4 買、四天合計 32 萬張）。記憶體續強——南亞科盤中創 542 元歷史新高、剛獲納入 MSCI 全球標準型指數台股成分股，華邦電盤中來到 191 元、漲逾 7%；老 AI 股集體翻身——仁寶第二季 EPS 0.73 元、股價直奔漲停 43.2 元，華碩首度突破千元，緯創、緯穎同創歷史新高，英業達、宏碁漲逾半根停板；軍工股因立院放行 634 億元無人機預算，漢翔、雷虎、亞航、龍德造船、長榮航太、邑錡 6 檔亮燈漲停。反向的是群聯：上半年每股賺 187.43 元、每股配 60 元雙雙破紀錄，利多鈍化反而開高翻黑跌逾 3%。　【美股】三大指數自週四的歷史新高小幅回落：道瓊收 53,732 點（-108 點、-0.20%）、S&P 500 約 -0.2%、那斯達克約 -0.3%。轉折點是密西根大學 8 月消費者信心初值走弱、通膨預期仍高，抵銷了前一天 PPI 降溫的利多。但週線仍是連三週收紅。個股才是真正的故事：Reddit（RDDT）確定 8/18 盤前納入 S&P 500、取代被 Equity Residential 併購的 AvalonBay，股價大漲約 12.6% 至 178.09 美元，成為繼 Meta 之後第二檔純社群股入列；SanDisk（SNDK）投資人日公布 2030 藍圖、非 GAAP 毛利率上看 80%，漲逾 6%；AMD +5.06%、Seagate（STX）+5.12%、Copart（CPRT）+7.06%、Nu Holdings（NU）+10.59%。
market.highlight: ⚠️ 這個週末值得想清楚的三件事：　① 記憶體＋儲存是台美同步的唯一主線。台股這邊南亞科創歷史新高並入列 MSCI、華邦電盤中漲逾 7%、力積電被外資連 4 買 32 萬張；美股那邊 SanDisk 喊出 80% 毛利率、Seagate 漲 5%、Micron 同步走強。這不是台股自己的行情，是全球 NAND/DRAM 供給結構性偏緊的同一件事在兩個市場同時反映。要留意的是，這已經是連續多日的族群輪動，追高的風險隨每一根往上而增加。　② 台積電尾盤下殺是這週最需要記住的訊號。-1.64% 本身不大，但「最後一盤下殺」通常代表法人在收盤價上動手，而不是散戶追殺。加權指數 46K 得而復失、外資卻同時買超 453 億，代表資金正在從權值股搬到中小型記憶體與 AI 硬體。這種結構對指數不利、對個股有利，但也最容易在某一天同時反轉。　③ Reddit 8/18 正式納入 S&P 500。指數型基金必須在生效前買進，這種被動買盤通常在宣布日到生效日之間就消化完，等到 8/18 當天反而常見獲利了結。這是教科書等級的「index inclusion effect」案例，值得當成觀察題而不是進場題。　另外提醒：今天 8/15 是週六，台美股都休市，下一個交易日是 8/18（一）。
